fusions.name: Hoof After Hoof
fusions.desc: A hoof-strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterwards. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ridden Into the Ground
fusions.desc: Tramples the ground around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Mile-Eating Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
